title: Build account and symbol serialized order command coordinator
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent ENTRY_LONG commands for the same (mode, account, symbol) produce exactly one AUTHORIZED decision in a deterministic asyncio test
Concurrent entries on different symbols of one account whose combined cost exceeds available cash reserve cash for exactly one; the other is REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH
The same symbol on two different accounts/modes is authorized independently and shares no lock or reservation state
Signal expiry and quote staleness are evaluated with the injected clock inside the critical section; a signal that expires while waiting for the lock is rejected
EXIT_LONG quantity greater than confirmed held quantity minus committed working-sell quantity is REJECTED_OVERSELL; a conflict with an active protective stop yields REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL
Cash reservations, releases, and consumption hooks use Decimal exclusively, and release restores the exact prior available amount
The coordinator performs no broker calls or order submission
tests/unit/test_order_serialization.py passes without network access or broker credentials
forbidden_changes: edit order_fsm.py or intents.py (owned by concurrent task f.1)
change PLAN_SKELETON.json or any planning artifacts
call broker APIs or submit orders from the coordinator
share locks, reservations, or state across modes/accounts
authorize any sell that could exceed confirmed remaining long quantity
use float for money or quantities
run broad test suites or backtests
